anchors.quote: Exposure is the sum of the amounts of eligible holdings in the complete inventory. Ineligible holdings contribute zero. An empty complete inventory has zero exposure. Negative amounts are permitted. Each item represents a distinct position; do not deduplicate equal values.

assumptions: The supplied holdings list is the complete inventory, with eligibility already determined for every position.
Amounts are decimal HKD values; no currency conversion or monetary rounding is applied.
value.interpretation: Sum each eligible holding's amount, retaining negative amounts and repeated equal values as distinct positions. Ineligible holdings contribute zero, and an empty inventory sums to zero.
value.source:
```catala
scope Portfolio:
  definition exposure equals
    sum decimal of (map each holding among holdings to
      if holding.eligible then holding.amount else 0.0)
```
